caption: The drawing shows a single brown leather bag or box with a rounded rectangular form, placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The object has a lid that fits over the top, slightly curved and outlined with fine shading to suggest dimension. Visible in the front is a leather strap with a buckle, and metal studs line the upper seam where the lid meets the body. On the right side of the box, there is a metal ring attached to a small leather loop. The entire bag has a weathered appearance, with darker patches and highlights indicative of creases and wear on the surface. There are no other objects or discernible features in the composition, and the focus is solely on the single brown bag.
title: Storage Box (Copper)
